title: Body-Relative Shell and Effective-Potential Registry
negative_results: the 8 <-> 0 shell closure is stored as SOURCE ontology and is NOT auto-applied; apply_shell_closure(8) refuses by default
the closure resolves 8 -> 0 only with an explicit apply_closure=True opt-in
an unknown shell index (9, -1, or wrong type) is refused
a shell state with an out-of-range index is refused
a shell definition marked literal=True is refused (labels are nonliteral)
a shell labelled with a non-source claim class is refused

claims.statement: Shells 0..8 are represented with surface semantics and altitude bands as SOURCE ontology; shell labels are nonliteral.
The 8 <-> 0 shell closure is stored as source ontology and is never silently applied to a codec (System Contract invariant 8).
A shell ontology label is at most SOURCE_CLAIM or MATHEMATICAL_TRANSLATION and is never a physical or geographic claim.
